notes.title: Update v1.0.4
notes.content:
Changes

 French and Spanish (machine-translated) have been added as supported languages.

Thanks,

- Thunderfox Studio

notes.title: Update v1.0.3
notes.content:
Changes

 In “Crescent” and “Full Moon”, the monster’s close-range vision has been slightly adjusted.
 In “Crescent” and “Full Moon”, crouch-walking no longer triggers the monster with footstep noise.
 New statistics such as distance traveled and flashlight usage time have been added to the game clear screen.
 Russian (machine-translated) has been added as a supported language.

Thanks,

- Thunderfox Studio

notes.title: Update v1.0.2
notes.content:
Changes

 The difficulty of "Crescent" and "Full Moon" has been slightly reduced.
 Pulling the "Energy Supply Unit" from the "Container" in the "Spaceport" is now easier.
 Performance has been optimized for low-end systems.
 German (machine-translated) has been added as a supported language.

Thanks,

- Thunderfox Studio

notes.title: Update v1.0.1
notes.content:
Changes

 Improved the screen to look less blurry when the Pixel Perfect option is disabled.
 Fixed a few minor bugs.

I hope to deliver more interesting changes in the next update.
Thanks,

- Thunderfox Studio

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Happy New Year!

The demo has been updated to version DEMO104. Here are the changes:

Content Changes

 The containers in the Spaceport can now be opened with a button.
 The names of the Dome Garden and Greenhouse Station are now displayed on the map.
 The lights in the Fusion Reactor no longer flickers due to monster activity.
 Some monster behaviors have been adjusted.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where the scene would break if "Death from Oxygen Deprivation" and "Death by Enemy Capture" occurred simultaneously.
 Fixed an issue where monsters could interact with players through closed doors.

Misc.

 Keyboard input is now supported in the UI.

notes.title: Release Date Announcement and Demo Update
notes.content:
Hello. This is the developer of Moonbase Lambda.
Thank you so much for your patience for the release of the game.

I’d like to inform you that the final release date has been set for March 7, 2025.

During the development process, I tested the game many times on myself and felt that the game became overly repetitive as players became more skilled. While the simple style of the game can be a strength, gameplay that feels monotonous is a flaw I cannot ignore.
To address this issue and make play more tense, I decided to add a new monster, which has inevitably extended the development schedule.

As this is my first project, there are many aspects that are lacking, including schedule management.
I sincerely apologize and ask for your kind understanding.

I will do my best to create a game worthy of a spot in your library.

Best Regards,
The developer.

Changes in DEMO103 Version:
Content Updates

 Added a UI that shows stamina recovery speed.
 Improved the appearance of battery charging stations to make them more noticeable.
 Introduced various new sound effects and background music.
 Removed the "Stable" dithering option.
 Added an option to control displaying hints.
 Increased item spawn rates in certain areas.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue that occurred when a monster was touched during an interaction.

Misc

 Updated translations for Simplified and Traditional Chinese.

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
The demo has been updated to version DEMO101.

Content Changes

 Changed depleted batteries to be spawned at eye level.
 Added signage to the entrance of the mission area.
 The name of the mission area is now displayed on the map of the generator.
 Removed the feature to zoom in with the right mouse click.
 You can now see the controls in the pause menu.


Bug fixes

 Fixed an issue where items would spawn in the same place.
 Fixed an issue where some windows could be passed through.
 Fixed an issue where you could use an energy supply unit without batteries.


Misc

 Changed loading animations.
